## Projects
- [ForgeMind](https://github.com/Cod4Nitish/ForgeMind): AI software engineer that triages GitHub issues and coordinates Jira and Slack work (Next.js, TypeScript, LangGraph.js, Claude). Live demo: https://forgemind-ashy.vercel.app
- [MRStay AI](https://github.com/Cod4Nitish/MRStay_AI): agentic real-estate assistant for lead qualification and property recommendations (Python, FastAPI, Gemini, ChromaDB).
- [PhishGuard AI](https://github.com/Cod4Nitish/PhishGuard-AI): phishing-awareness and URL-security UX prototype with simulated scans (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS). Live demo: https://cod4nitish.github.io/PhishGuard-AI/
- [Developer Portfolio](https://github.com/Cod4Nitish/portfolio): this site (React, Vite, Framer Motion, GitHub Pages).
